title: luismc-delivery .delivery/config.json
description: Schema of the per-project config (plugin 0.2.0). Validated by `delivery_config.py validate`, which reads the JSON Schema subset used here (type, enum, const, properties, items, minimum, minItems, pattern, oneOf, additionalProperties). Keys starting with _ are comments. Keys not listed warn (they never fail). Every key is optional; a 0.1.0 config stays valid.

work_root.description: Folder agent worktrees live under (DL-53); empty = not checked.

tz.description: IANA zone of the owner (e.g. Europe/Lisbon). Must load through zoneinfo; if it cannot (no tzdata) validate and delivery_doctor.py fail, and hooks warn on stderr before falling back to UTC.

train_label_re.description: DL-64: labels the reply must not use instead of RELEASE-n.

train_branch_re.description: Head branches that are trains (runner_plan.train_branch_regex falls back to it).

brief_markers.description: DL-36: strings every cloud brief must contain.

question_window_min.description: Q-5: minutes a question batch counts as recent while this session's agents run (default 60).

question_batch_sec.description: Q-1: AskUserQuestion calls this many seconds after the previous batch belong to the same message (default 90).

no_attribution.description: DL-74: refuse AI attribution in commits and PR text.

watcher_interval_s.description: 0.1.0 name kept for old configs; watch_interval wins.

local_runners.description: Runner names that live on the owner's PC.

mode.description: block: a finding blocks the end of the turn. warn: it is shown as a systemMessage and the turn ends.

block_ceiling.description: The same findings block at most this many times per session, then the turn ends (artifacts R8.4). Replaces the hard-coded 3.

log_every_block.description: Append every block to .delivery/blocks.log: time, hook, rule id, message.

watcher.description: What delivery_watch.py is allowed to do (0.2.0). All default true, which is 0.1.0 behaviour.

open_prs.description: Open the ready PR of a pushed train that has none.

merge_on_green.description: Merge a train whose CI is green for its current head (D5), only if the head SHA is unchanged since the green run.

merge_flag.description: Alias of merge_method kept as written in comics-organizer.

never_auto_merge.description: Documentation of D5; `gh pr merge --auto` is never run whatever this says (false is an error).

ci_workflows.description: Workflow files that must all complete with success on the PR head before a train is green (default ["ci.yml"]). A completed sibling workflow never counts for another.

repair.description: Run in order when the runner is offline: a string through the shell, a list as argv.

cancel_replaced_runs.description: Watcher cancels CI runs of a branch whose head has moved on.

hold_dependabot_during_train.description: Watcher cancels and later re-runs non-train CI runs while a train's CI runs.

heavy_jobs_yield.description: runner_plan.py run waits for train CI before starting a heavy job.

script.description: Path of runner_plan.py for the watcher (default scripts/delivery/runner_plan.py under the repository root).

pr_proven_jobs.description: DL-76: job names the release PR proves; none may run on the default branch after the release merges (default [], check off).

stop_repeat_limit.description: The Stop hook stops blocking a finding that blocked this many turn ends in a row with no change to the ledger fields it depends on, and announces it once per session. 0 = never limit.

cleanup_command.description: DL-14: the project's cleanup command, {pr} is the PR number; the Stop message names it, then the plugin command that records the result.

smoke_command.description: DL-18: the project's production smoke command, {pr} is the PR number; named in the Stop message like cleanup_command.

smoke_workflow.description: Name of the workflow that `delivery_ledger.py smoke` looks for on the PR's merge commit.
